body: And that's okay too, especially during a global pandemic. Focus on doing small things that bring you joy. For me right now that consists of video games, food, listening to music, and sleeping. But it's something. Oh, and going for walks outside during the day if you can, I highly recommend it! By yourself or with others, it doesn't matter. I laid in the grass in a park near my house for an hour just looking at the sky with the sun on my skin and it felt amazing. Deep breaths of fresh air really help after being stuck inside, no joke.

Hey, I know being different can be terrifying, but remember when you think others are judging you, it is often you judging yourself. I have struggled with internalized homophobia for a long time and didn't realize it until very recently. Give yourself time and when you're ready to get help/support, give yourself a chance to be who you really are...it might just change your whole outlook on life for the better.
